episodes.name: The Family Man
episodes.overview: Srikant Tiwari, a member of TASC, a discreet intelligence agency, is assigned to interrogate suspected ISIS recruits. Balancing his personal life with work becomes a challenge for this family man, and things get out of hand on both fronts.

episodes.name: Sleepers
episodes.overview: A scooter bomb goes off at Kala Ghoda. Srikant learns about a mission called Zulfiqar. Suspects in the blast case tell him about a drop box near Victoria College. He arranges for round-the-clock surveillance at the drop box location.

episodes.name: Anti-National
episodes.overview: When he finds out that one of the hospitalised prisoners is part of Mission Zulfiqar, Srikant interrogates the prisoner’s friend, Moosa, about it. Someone called Kareem has used the dropbox. TASC monitors Kareem’s hostel room, but Kareem gives them the slip.

episodes.name: Patriots
episodes.overview: TASC is in a quandary. They fear Kareem and his men have a devious plan. They get to Kareem’s car, only to realise that things are not what they seem.

episodes.name: Pariah
episodes.overview: ISI agent Sameer sends the Kala Ghoda bomber to Kashmir to execute Mission Zulfiqar. Srikant is ‘punished’ and sent to Kashmir, but when his boss, Kulkarni, tells him it was planned, Srikant starts digging into Zulfiqar.

episodes.name: Dance of Death
episodes.overview: Srikant discovers that he’s been after the wrong suspect all this time.

episodes.name: Paradise
episodes.overview: Srikant searches for Sajid at a wedding in Baramulla. Pakistan’s PM finds out about Zulfiqar and tries to stop it.

episodes.name: Act of War
episodes.overview: Srikant helps CIA locate Faizan, a wanted man hiding in Balochistan. Srikant slips into Pakistan to interrogate Faizan.

episodes.name: Fighting Dirty
episodes.overview: Srikant tries to thwart a plan to smuggle nerve gas canisters from Kashmir into Delhi.

episodes.name: The Bomb
episodes.overview: TASC realises that Mission Zulfiqar is not over. There is a Plan B. And it has already been put to action.

episodes.name: Exile
episodes.overview: Srikant Tiwari has started a new life as an IT employee, but he can't stay away from adventure when JK is sent to Chennai to nab a former foreign insurgent. Chennai TASC agent, Muthu and JK are faced with a hostage situation in Chennai. And Dhriti may have a boyfriend.

episodes.name: Weapon
episodes.overview: Suchitra wants Srikant to go for couple counselling. Prime Minister Basu wants to make up for India's recent foreign policy faux pas. Bhaskaran activates an elite unit with Major Sameer's help. A creep harasses Raji.

episodes.name: Angel of Death
episodes.overview: Suchitra's birthday dinner triggers a showdown between Srikant and Suchitra. Srikant quits his IT job and joins back TASC. Raji's boss is onto her secret life and blackmails her.

episodes.name: Eagle
episodes.overview: Srikant starts investigating in Chennai. Sajid teams up with Selva and Raji. Wonder who they are targeting! Inspector Umayal starts investigating Nanda's disappearance.

episodes.name: Homecoming
episodes.overview: Inspector Umayal wants to join the TASC team in their mission. All roads lead to the old base.

episodes.name: Martyrs
episodes.overview: Srikant and team manage to nab Raji. But they find out the hard way that they are way in over their heads. TASC suffers a tragic loss.

episodes.name: Collateral Damage
episodes.overview: Raji is injured days before the D-Day and needs treatment. Simmering tensions between Suchitra and Dhriti hit a crescendo. Sajid bids adieu to Raji, for he has another, personal mission to accomplish in Mumbai. Meanwhile, Srikant is hit by another debilitating personal crisis.

episodes.name: Vendetta
episodes.overview: The hunt is on for Dhriti. Meanwhile, JK and Muthu decide to check out Tigris Aviation, and walk into a trap. Dhriti's loss of innocence is gruesome.

episodes.name: The Final Act
episodes.overview: News about JK forces Srikant to rush back to Chennai. Raji hears about Sajid's fate. Dhriti finds out the true nature of Srikant's job. Prime Minister Basu reaches Chennai for bilateral talks with the Lankan President, Rupatunga. Srikant and team race against time to prevent a deadly attack on the two premiers.

episodes.name: The Peace Problem
episodes.overview: Explosions send tremors across the Northeast, shaking Prime Minister Basu’s peace agenda. As Srikant and Kulkarni step into fragile negotiations with wary Naga leaders, enemies within and beyond the borders lurk in the shadows, armed with deadly intent.

episodes.name: It's Personal
episodes.overview: Recovering from a deadly ambush, Srikant traces the trail to an elusive Rukma, unaware that his pursuit has already drawn the gaze of Meera and her powerful backers abroad. As the hunt turns violent, lives are lost, allegiances tested, and Srikant is pulled deeper and deeper into a dangerous game.

episodes.name: Wanted Man
episodes.overview: As a smear campaign engulfs his family, Srikant faces crumbling trust at home and rising threats outside. With no end in sight and his family caught in the storm, he makes a drastic choice that changes everything. Meanwhile, Rukma struggles with a responsibility he cannot escape.

episodes.name: Don’t Worry Be Happy
episodes.overview: As Srikant and his family flee deeper into the Northeast, Yatish and Zoya close in with their team. In Kohima, Rukma forces young Bobby into a deadly mission, turning the Prime Minister’s peace rally into the stage for his most dangerous strike yet.

episodes.name: Crossing The Line
episodes.overview: Under fire after the Kohima blast, PM Basu authorises a high-risk strike across the border. Rukma and Meera forge a treacherous alliance in Myanmar to set their dangerous plan in motion. Srikant gets a lead from a source that spirals into chaos.

episodes.name: With Friends Like You...
episodes.overview: Fallout from the failed Myanmar strike rattles PM Basu’s leadership in Delhi. Srikant uncovers Rukma’s link to Meera. As hidden moles and betrayals surface, Zoya intercepts a plot against Srikant’s family. The battle between truth and deception reaches its breaking point.

episodes.name: Endgame
episodes.overview: As PM Basu gets ready for war, Srikant plunges into hostile territory where traps and betrayals wait at every turn. With Rukma closing in for revenge and Meera slipping further from reach, shifting allegiances and hidden agendas push Srikant toward a brutal reckoning that could change everything.

titles.name: Money Heist
titles.overview: To carry out the biggest heist in history, a mysterious man called The Professor recruits a band of eight robbers who have a single characteristic: none of them has anything to lose. Five months of seclusion - memorizing every step, every detail, every probability - culminate in eleven days locked up in the National Coinage and Stamp Factory of Spain, surrounded by police forces and with dozens of hostages in their power, to find out whether their suicide wager will lead to everything or nothing.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: The Professor recruits a young female robber and seven other criminals for a grand heist, targeting the Royal Mint of Spain.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Hostage negotiator Raquel makes initial contact with the Professor. Police grab an image of the face of one of the robbers.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Raquel suffers a personal crisis with her ex. The hostages are frightened by the gunshots they overheard. The thieves argue among themselves.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: The thieves let a medical team enter the Mint, and an undercover policemansneaks in with them. Can the Professor stay one step ahead of Raquel?

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Rio is disturbed by news he sees on the television. A break in the investigation puts the Professor at risk of being discovered.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Berlin seeks revenge once his identity is revealed in the press. Tokyo catches Alison chatting with Rio and confronts her.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Raquel enters the Mint to secure proof of life that all of the hostages are still alive and well. Nairobi gives Alison advice.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Arturo formulates an escape plan for a group of hostages. Ángel and Raquel question each other's loyalties. Mónica makes a move on Denver.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The Professor reveals who gave him the idea for the plan. At the Mint, the thieves offer the hostages a decision: money or freedom?

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: As forensic experts comb the Toledocountry house for DNA, the Professor loses control. Inside the Mint, the robbers' nerves reach a breaking point.

episodes.name: Episode 11
episodes.overview: The police interrogate the first robber to be captured. Furious over Berlin's recent actions, Rio takes a stand against him.

episodes.name: Episode 12
episodes.overview: Recognizing their plan isn't working out, the robbers instead aim to win over the public via the press. Raquel sets a trap to capture the Professor.

episodes.name: Episode 13
episodes.overview: Arturo faces harsh consequences for trying to set another escape plan in motion. After making a confession, Moscow loses Denver's trust.

episodes.name: Episode 14
episodes.overview: When Raquel's relationship with the Professor is discovered and she's removed from the case, she decides to conduct her own search for the mastermind.

episodes.name: Episode 15
episodes.overview: As the police enter the Mint, Berlín leads the robbers in a final showdown. Will they escape with the 984 million euros—and with their lives intact?

episodes.name: We're Back
episodes.overview: When Rio is captured, a distraught Tokyo turns to the Professor for help. Armed with a bold new plan, they reunite the team in order to rescue him.

episodes.name: Aikido
episodes.overview: The Professor recruits Martin to put his brother's plan into action and target the Bank of Spain. First step? Create total chaos.

episodes.name: 48 Meters Underground
episodes.overview: Tokyo and Nairobi's efforts go drastically awry. The Professor recalls Berlin detailing how they'd steal the gold from the water-logged vault.

episodes.name: It's Dolphin Time
episodes.overview: Tamayo's breaches of protocol surprise the Professor. Bogota calms Denver's anxieties. With time running out, Palermo initiates the "Flipper" plan.

episodes.name: Boom, Boom, Ciao
episodes.overview: The Professor shocks officials with his latest stunt, but in response, a new inspector rattles Raquel. Palermo and Nairobi get into a heated argument.

episodes.name: Everything Seemed Insignificant
episodes.overview: Just as Inspector Sierra orchestrates a plan to sneak a team into the Bank of Spain, the Professor and Raquel lose communication with Palermo.

episodes.name: A Quick Vacation
episodes.overview: Tokyo's happiness turns bittersweet. Angel closes in on a quarreling Raquel and the Professor. Authorities offer a multimillion-dollar reward for tips.

episodes.name: Astray
episodes.overview: Tokyo attempts to drown her sorrows. Sierra uses personal tactics to target a vulnerable Nairobi, while Suarez continues to hunt down Raquel.

episodes.name: Game Over
episodes.overview: Anger and grief heighten tensions between the group. The Professor, while in mourning, attempts to make a daring and dangerous escape.

episodes.name: Berlin's Wedding
episodes.overview: Palermo shocks the group with his actions. Sierra pressures her subject to take a deal. The Professor remembers his brother's wedding.

episodes.name: Anatomy Lesson
episodes.overview: The Professor's mole attempts to pass along his message to the person inside the tent. Denver's jealousy toward Mónica and Rio's friendship heightens.

episodes.name: Pasodoble
episodes.overview: In the past, Berlin predicts that Gandía will cause problems for the operation. Sierra's interrogation of Lisboa leads to a personal revelation.

episodes.name: 5 Minutes Earlier
episodes.overview: Denver turns to an undercover source for help. Nairobi attempts to motivate her team as the danger around them intensifies.

episodes.name: TKO
episodes.overview: With Nairobi held hostage, Gandía negotiates with the crew. The Professor desperately seeks a new plan to save his team.

episodes.name: Strike the Tent
episodes.overview: The group reels following the attack on one of their own. The Professor puts his adjusted plan in motion with the help of new recruits and Palermo.

episodes.name: The Paris Plan
episodes.overview: The Professor, Benjamin and the others attempt to free Lisboa. Tokyo's anger threatens her faith in the plan. Sierra takes matters into her own hands.

episodes.name: The End of the Road
episodes.overview: The Professor faces off with Sierra as Tamayo raises the stakes of the negotiations by calling the army. In the past, Berlin meets with a family member.

episodes.name: Do You Believe in Reincarnation?
episodes.overview: Arturo seizes an opportunity to fight back while escalating a personal vengeance. Lisbon makes a crucial discovery.

episodes.name: The Spectacle of Life
episodes.overview: A betrayaland an emergency both catch Sierra by surprise. Palermo rallies the troops as the army closes in on the gang.

episodes.name: Your Place in Heaven
episodes.overview: With Helsinki's life in danger, the thieves mount a covert counter attack. Years earlier, Berlin and his son conduct their first heist together.

episodes.name: Live Many Lives
episodes.overview: While surrounded by gunfire and trapped in the kitchen, Tokyo reminisces about her first love and her initial encounter with the Professor.

episodes.name: Escape Valve
episodes.overview: Sierra takes advantage of the Professor's grief and gains the upper hand. Meanwhile, the team deals with the emotional fallout of their dead friend.

episodes.name: Wishful Thinking
episodes.overview: Tamayo mounts a manhunt in his neighborhood as his foes hide. In the past, Berlin and Palermo explain how they plan on getting the gold out of the bank.

episodes.name: The Elegance Theory
episodes.overview: Tamayo hunts for the gold as the team races against the clock. Mónica worries she's having a psychotic break. Years earlier, Berlin is deceived.

episodes.name: Pillow Talk
episodes.overview: The Professor is left reeling after his tactics are used against him, and when it seems like all hope is lost, he makes a bold decision.

episodes.name: A Family Tradition
episodes.overview: With multiple lives on the line and Spain's economy at stake, the Professor and Tamayo engage in one final showdown.

titles.name: Attack on Titan
titles.overview: 100 years ago, the last remnants of humanity were forced to retreat behind the towering walls of a fortified city to escape the massive, man-eating Titans that roamed the land outside their fortress. Only the members of the Scouting Legion dared to stray beyond the safety of the walls – but even those brave warriors seldom returned alive. Those within the city clung to the illusion of a peaceful existence until the day that dream was shattered, and their slim chance at survival was reduced to one horrifying choice: kill – or be devoured!

trailers.name: Official Trailer w/ Intro from Voice of Eren

episodes.name: To You, in 2000 Years: The Fall of Shiganshina (1)
episodes.overview: After one hundred years of peace, humanity is suddenly reminded of the terror of being at the Titans' mercy.

episodes.name: That Day: The Fall of Shiganshina (2)
episodes.overview: After the Titans break through the wall, the citizens of Shiganshina must run for their lives. However, those that do make it to safety find a harsh life waiting for them.

episodes.name: A Dim Light Amid Despair: Humanity's Comeback (1)
episodes.overview: Eren begins his training with the Cadet Corps, but questions about his painful past overwhelm him. When he struggles with a maneuvering exercise, Bertolt and Reiner offer kindly advice.

episodes.name: The Night of the Closing Ceremony: Humanity's Comeback (2)
episodes.overview: Two years pass and the time for the recruits' graduation approaches. Annie proves her skill in a sparring session, Jean dreams of serving alongside the King, and graduation day brings shocking revelations — along with the sudden appearance of an old foe.

episodes.name: First Battle: The Struggle for Trost (1)
episodes.overview: Five years have passed since the fall of Wall Maria and Eren faces off against the Colossal Titan after it appears out of nowhere once again, and knocks a strategic hole in the gate of Wall Rose. As Titans swarm the city, the newly graduated Cadets are called in to fight a brutal battle that won't be without casualties.

episodes.name: The World the Girl Saw: The Struggle for Trost (2)
episodes.overview: Armin tries to cope with the loss of his friends and allies after Titans massacre his squad. Elsewhere in the city, Mikasa manages to take out several of the monsters, which brings back tragic memories of her past and the first time she met Eren.

episodes.name: Small Blade: The Struggle for Trost (3)
episodes.overview: After the retreat bell sounds, many cadets find themselves without enough fuel to scale the wall back to safety. Mikasa begins to lose hope once she hears of the deaths in Armin's squad, but the appearance of a new type of Titan stokes her will to fight.

episodes.name: I Can Hear His Heartbeat: The Struggle for Trost (4)
episodes.overview: Armin comes up with a risky plan that pits Titan against Titan as the abandoned cadets attempt to take back their headquarters. Getting into the building might be possible, but getting out alive and refueled will mean facing more of the giants.

episodes.name: Whereabouts of His Left Arm: The Struggle for Trost (5)
episodes.overview: A miraculous return is met with anger and fear. Cannons are fixed on Eren as he struggles to remember what happened to him inside the belly of a Titan and how he ended up as humankind's enemy. One question is all that matters: is Eren human or Titan?

episodes.name: Response: The Struggle for Trost (6)
episodes.overview: Cadets respond to Eren's terrifying transformation with doubt and fear as he struggles to understand it himself. If Armin can’t talk the commander into using Eren’s newfound powers for the good of humankind, all hope of stopping the Titans might be lost.

episodes.name: Idol: The Struggle for Trost (7)
episodes.overview: Plans are made to use Eren's Titan powers to seal the hole in the wall in an attempt reclaim Trost. But with the government's bloodstained history and vocal dissenters in the military ranks, the biggest threat to humankind may not be the Titans.

episodes.name: Wound: The Struggle for Trost (8)
episodes.overview: The plan to reclaim Trost falls apart when Eren's newfound powers turn him into a mindless giant. As Titans continue to swarm the city, it's up to Armin and Mikasa to make sure the cadets massacred during the mission haven't died in vain.

episodes.name: Primal Desire: The Struggle for Trost (9)
episodes.overview: Jean takes desperate measures to replace his broken Maneuver Gear. Meanwhile, Eren is able to seal the hole in the wall thanks to the help of his fellow cadets, but the cost of humanity's first victory against the Titans will be enormous.

episodes.name: Can't Look into His Eyes Yet: Eve of the Counterattack (1)
episodes.overview: A special military tribunal will decide Eren's fate. The Military Police calls for his execution while the Recon Corps argues that he is a powerful resource for humankind, and Mikasa is put on the spot when asked about the events of the Trost mission.

episodes.name: Special Operations Squad: Eve of the Counterattack (2)
episodes.overview: The Recon Corps moves Eren to an old abandoned castle where he will continue his training. Hange visits and reveals that she's been putting two captured Titans through a series of tests and trials — experiments that she wants Eren's help with.

episodes.name: What Needs to Be Done Now: Eve of the Counterattack (3)
episodes.overview: Everyone is a suspect in the investigation to find out who killed the two test-subject Titans. Meanwhile, the cadets pick which military branch they'll be joining, but after the harrowing events in the Trost attack, many are uncertain which branch to choose.

episodes.name: Female Titan: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (1)
episodes.overview: As the Recon Corps begins its push toward Shiganshina, they encounter an intelligent Female Titan unlike any they've seen before. When Armin hypothesizes that it's really a human that's been turned into a Titan, he, Jean, and Reiner attempt to stop it.

episodes.name: Forest of Giant Trees: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (2)
episodes.overview: As the Female Titan continues to tear its way through the Recon Corps, Levi makes a bold decision to split the ranks and send Eren and the supply wagons through a huge forest. Is his strategy genius, or does it spell certain death for the scouts?

episodes.name: Bite: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (3)
episodes.overview: With the Female Titan still chasing after Levi's squad, Eren considers turning himself into his Titan form, but Levi tells him to choose to be either a monster or a member of the Recon Corps. As Eren remembers what he has learned from the squad, he realizes that the danger and sacrifice they all share is not what binds them — it is trust. Now it is up to Eren to make the decision of who he will trust.

episodes.name: Erwin Smith: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (4)
episodes.overview: With the help of Levi's squad, the Recon Corps has successfully captured the Female Titan. As Commander Erwin and Captain Levi begin preparations to extract whoever is inside the Titan, will the Recon Corps discover its true identity, or does the Female Titan have one last trick up its sleeve?

episodes.name: Crushing Blow: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (5)
episodes.overview: After a last act of desperation, the person inside the Female Titan has escaped from the Recon Corps and reverted to their human form. Now, disguised as a member of the Recon Corps and equipped with Maneuver Gear, they finally catch up to their prey — Levi's squad.

episodes.name: The Defeated: The 57th Exterior Scouting Mission (6)
episodes.overview: The Female Titan has captured Eren after ripping him out of his Titan body, but Mikasa and Captain Levi give chase. Elsewhere, the Recon Corps begins preparations for the journey back home to the Wall with their numerous dead in tow.

episodes.name: Smile: Assault on Stohess (1)
episodes.overview: Following the disastrous results of the 57th Expedition, Eren is to be brought to the King’s palace for a court martial. Armin, desperate to save Eren from certain execution, enlists the help of an old friend to assist with an escape plan.

episodes.name: Mercy: Assault on Stohess (2)
episodes.overview: With the identity of the Female Titan now revealed, Eren has reservations about fighting her. Mikasa, Armin, and the rest of the Recon Corps try to fight the Female Titan, hoping to distract her long enough to buy Eren time to come to terms with his feelings.

episodes.name: Wall: Assault on Stohess (3)
episodes.overview: Eren, spurred on by his promise to kill every single Titan, unleashes the full power of his Titan form in the fight with the Female Titan. As their bloody battle draws to a close, it seems humanity may finally have a chance at survival. However, with many mysteries still left unsolved, what will await Eren, Mikasa, and Armin?

episodes.name: Beast Titan
episodes.overview: Coupled with the military's cover-up of a previous incident, the shocking discovery inside the Walls causes a stir. Elsewhere, while the new Scout recruits are held for observation, a surprising threat appears.

episodes.name: I'm Home
episodes.overview: With the appearance of Titans within Wall Rose, Sasha and Connie ride as messengers to warn their villages of the impending threat.

episodes.name: Southwestward
episodes.overview: The Scouts search for a hole in the wall while Eren and the others learn that someone close may be hiding all the answers.

episodes.name: Soldier
episodes.overview: Unarmed and overwhelmed by the Titan assault on the castle, the only hope for the Scouts may lie in a promise and a secret.

episodes.name: Historia
episodes.overview: Utgard Castle comes crumbling down as Ymir desperately battles the Titans. Now, Christa must fulfill the promise they made long ago during winter training.

episodes.name: Warrior
episodes.overview: Following the battle, the Scouts regroup atop the wall only to find more questions than answers.

episodes.name: Close Combat
episodes.overview: With a new enemy revealed, Eren and the Scouts fight back using all the techniques at their disposal.

episodes.name: The Hunters
episodes.overview: Without a way to pursue the Titans, the Scouts have no choice but to recuperate as they wait for reinforcements. But do they still have faith in Eren?

episodes.name: Opening
episodes.overview: The Scouts rally and charge in pursuit, but Reiner is not quite himself while the group is trapped in the giant forest until nightfall.

episodes.name: Children
episodes.overview: When their group finally flees, Ymir wonders whether she should lie or stay true to herself, even if it means ruining the lives and future of those she cares about.

episodes.name: Charge
episodes.overview: The pursuit begins as the Recon Corps battles their way to Eren. But as the Scouts start to take numerous casualties, Erwin executes a risky strategy.

episodes.name: Scream
episodes.overview: The battle continues as Eren and the Scouts face many hard decisions. Who is the real enemy? What is the war really about? And what will the future hold for mankind?

episodes.name: Smoke Signal
episodes.overview: After barely surviving Eren's recovery, a rising threat from the shadows puts everyone's lives in danger again.

episodes.name: Pain
episodes.overview: The Scouts take a stand against a new enemy, but it's not just Titans they'll be fighting anymore.

episodes.name: Old Story
episodes.overview: Historia and Erwin look back on their past, revealing a shady government with a hidden agenda and inspiration for an uprising.

episodes.name: Trust
episodes.overview: On the run and running out of time, the Scouts must entrust their lives to others if they plan on surviving.

episodes.name: Reply
episodes.overview: Erwin pleads his case for the Scouts to be spared, but an unforeseen announcement puts the fate of humanity at risk.

episodes.name: Sin
episodes.overview: While sins of the past reveal new truths, both sides prepare for the upcoming showdown before they run out of time.

episodes.name: Wish
episodes.overview: As battle breaks out to prevent the ritual, Historia makes a shocking decision which leads to catastrophe.

episodes.name: Outside the Walls of Orvud District
episodes.overview: When everything falls apart, Eren must believe in himself to save his friends. But Eren alone may not be enough to stop the impending doom.

episodes.name: Ruler of the Walls
episodes.overview: The survey corps and the wall garrison must protect the Orvud District from the impending attack of Rod Reiss' titan.

episodes.name: Friends
episodes.overview: Kenny recalls the life which has brought him to death's door, but he gets to decide whether to live on or not.

episodes.name: Bystander
episodes.overview: Having seen a glimpse of his father's memories, Eren attempts to track down a man hoping they might shed some light on his father's secrets.

episodes.name: Night of the Battle to Retake the Wall
episodes.overview: The Scouts gather for a feisty feast before leaving to retake Wall Maria to uncover what's hidden in the basement once and for all.

episodes.name: The Town Where Everything Began
episodes.overview: The operation to retake Wall Maria commences in Shiganshina, the town where everything began. But when the Scouts arrive, something seems very wrong.

episodes.name: Thunder Spears
episodes.overview: Against a rush of enemies, the Scouts scramble to defend their horses. But despite falling into a trap, they have their own surprise for the Armored Titan.

episodes.name: Descent
episodes.overview: Though their Thunder Spears prove effective, the Scouts' celebration is short-lived as disaster descends upon Shiganshina.

episodes.name: Perfect Game
episodes.overview: While one front in the battle is rained on by flames, the other is battered by boulders. With no way out, the Scouts are forced to fight or die trying.

episodes.name: Hero
episodes.overview: As Erwin’s heroic charge buys Levi time to confront the Beast Titan, Armin comes up with a plan of his own that lays it all on the line.

episodes.name: Midnight Sun
episodes.overview: While picking up the pieces from the costly battle, tensions rise when deciding which of the wounded Scouts to use the single syringe on.

episodes.name: The Basement
episodes.overview: The Scouts reflect on all they have gained and lost in their mission. With their enemies gone, Eren and the Scouts finally enter the basement to uncover the truth that will change everything.

episodes.name: That Day
episodes.overview: A look into Grisha's memories shows Eren the many secrets his father was hiding, including one which led to his mother's demise.

episodes.name: The Attack Titan
episodes.overview: Eren learns the truth about his Titan powers, his Father and himself. The Survey Corps have a meeting that discusses the future of Eldia with all their new information.

episodes.name: The Other Side of the Wall
episodes.overview: Though it's met with hope and despair, the truth is made public. The Scouts then venture beyond the walls to see if it's everything they dreamed of.

episodes.name: The Other Side of the Sea
episodes.overview: As Marley battles the Mid-East Alliance to end a four-year war, a group of Warrior candidates on the front lines compete to be the successor of the Armored Titan.

episodes.name: Midnight Train
episodes.overview: Though glad the war is over, both the Eldian Warriors and Marley brass realize that neither have a future unless they finish the job of retaking the Founding Titan.

episodes.name: The Door of Hope
episodes.overview: Reiner reflects on his past, remembering what pushed him to become a Warrior and keep moving forward when all hope was lost.

episodes.name: From One Hand to Another
episodes.overview: A sudden visit from the Tybur family shakes up the Marleyan military. Meanwhile, Falco smuggles letters for a friend and helps two old comrades reunite.

episodes.name: Declaration of War
episodes.overview: While Willy Tybur reveals the truth in a shocking speech to the world, tensions rise behind the stage as Eren and Reiner meet face to face.

episodes.name: The War Hammer Titan
episodes.overview: Eren's rampage is thwarted by the War Hammer Titan whose tenacity leaves him stumped. With Marley's military joining the fight, he'll be hard-pressed to survive on his own.

episodes.name: Assault
episodes.overview: The forces of Paradis begin their assault, but the Warriors stand their ground. As Marley troops close in around them, Eren struggles to break the War Hammer's defenses.

episodes.name: Assassin's Bullet
episodes.overview: With no Titans left to threaten their escape, the Scouts retreat on the airship. Determined to make them pay for trampling on her home, Gabi chases after with gun in hand.

episodes.name: Brave Volunteers
episodes.overview: As Paradis deals with the aftermath of the raid on Liberio, Armin looks back in the past to meeting the volunteer soldiers who reshaped their world.

episodes.name: A Sound Argument
episodes.overview: Two years ago, Paradis welcomed their first visitor who was surprised to see one of their own. Obtaining their help will be critical in a three-part plan to protect Paradis.

episodes.name: Deceiver
episodes.overview: Trapped on the world's most dangerous island, Falco and Gabi will do anything to survive. Elsewhere, the public demands answers when they learn the savior of Paradis has been detained.

episodes.name: Guides
episodes.overview: While Hange and Pixis piece together Zeke's true intentions, tension builds outside HQ where Armin and Mikasa plead for permission to speak with Eren.

episodes.name: Children of the Forest
episodes.overview: Gabi and Falco seek out a fellow Marleyan who's surprised to see Warrior candidates. The truth of what happened at Ragako may shed some light on Zeke's secret plans.

episodes.name: Savagery
episodes.overview: Armin and Mikasa speak with Eren, but are astounded by what he says. In the forest, Levi considers feeding the Beast Titan to someone new, but Zeke has other plans in mind.

episodes.name: Sole Salvation
episodes.overview: A look into Zeke's past shows his struggle to become a Warrior. His plans to end the suffering of all Eldians stems from a chance friendship made in his youth.

episodes.name: Above and Below
episodes.overview: With the Yeagerists now in charge, Zeke's master plan is revealed. But before it is put in motion, Eren recruits help to flush out any invaders in their midst.

episodes.name: Judgment
episodes.overview: Caught off guard by Marley's surprise attack, Eren fends off their Titans alone. As the battle rages on above, the Scouts consider Eren's motives from the underground dungeons.

episodes.name: Sneak Attack
episodes.overview: The Beast Titan joins the fray, but General Magath is determined to take him down. Meanwhile, with the city in flames, Colt and Gabi rush to rescue Falco who's held captive by the Yeagerists.

episodes.name: Two Brothers
episodes.overview: Colt pleads with Zeke to not use his scream and turn Falco into a Titan. All the while, soldiers and Titans clash in battle as Eren struggles to make contact with his brother.

episodes.name: Memories of the Future
episodes.overview: Zeke takes Eren through Grisha's memories to show him how he's been brainwashed. But in doing so, Zeke discovers something about Eren that he never knew.

episodes.name: From You, 2,000 Years Ago
episodes.overview: For 2,000 years, the Founder Ymir has been waiting--a slave to those with royal blood. However, Eren's yearning for freedom gives her a choice that could shake things up.

episodes.name: Thaw
episodes.overview: With no walls left on the island and Shiganshina full of Titans, the Scouts must battle their former comrades. In the midst of it all, Gabi is determined to find and rescue Falco at whatever cost.

episodes.name: Sunset
episodes.overview: The rumbling is set in motion once all hardening is undone, but this also sets Annie free. As the Jaegerists take control of the island, Conny races towards Ragako to feed Falco to his Titan mother.

episodes.name: Pride
episodes.overview: Upon reaching Ragako, Conny hatches a plan to trick Falco into being eaten by his mother. Elsewhere, hero of the Eldian Empire, Jean, is to execute Yelena and Onyankopon for their crimes against humanity.

episodes.name: Night of the End
episodes.overview: Deep in the forest, an unlikely rabble of Marley stragglers and island fugitives attempt to set their hatred aside and talk around a campfire without killing each other.

episodes.name: Traitor
episodes.overview: The Azumabito's flying boat is guarded by a port full of Jaegerists, but the Scouts are reluctant to kill their former friends. If they wish to avoid bloodshed, they can't afford their plan to go wrong.

episodes.name: Retrospective
episodes.overview: For the flying boat to take off, the mechanics need half a day to service it. Knowing they'll never last that long with Jaegerist reinforcements on the way, the crew is forced to change their plans.

episodes.name: The Dawn of Humanity
episodes.overview: Regardless of where it all began, Eren commits to his path of destruction during the Scouts' first visit to the Marleyan mainland, leaving Mikasa to wonder if things could've been different.

titles.name: Chernobyl
titles.overview: The true story of one of the worst man-made catastrophes in history: the catastrophic nuclear accident at Chernobyl. A tale of the brave men and women who sacrificed to save Europe from unimaginable disaster.

episodes.overview: April 26, 1986, Ukrainian SSR. Plant workers and firefighters put their lives on the line to control a catastrophic 1986 explosion at a Soviet nuclear power plant.

episodes.name: Please Remain Calm
episodes.overview: With untold millions at risk after the Chernobyl explosion, nuclear physicist Ulana Khomyuk makes a desperate attempt to reach Valery Legasov, a leading Soviet nuclear physicist, and warn him about the threat of second explosion that could devastate the continent.

episodes.name: Open Wide, O Earth
episodes.overview: Lyudmilla Ignatenko, a Pripyat resident, ignores warning about her firefighter husband's contamination. Valery Legasov lays out a decontamination plan, complete with human risks.

episodes.name: The Happiness of All Mankind
episodes.overview: Valery Legasov and Soviet Deputy Prime Minister Boris Shcherbina consider using lunar rovers to remove radioactive debris, while Ulana Khomyuk faces government hurdles in determining the truth about the cause of the explosion.

episodes.name: Vichnaya Pamyat
episodes.overview: Valery Legasov, Boris Shcherbina and Ulana Khomyuk risk their lives and reputations to expose the truth about Chernobyl.

titles.name: The Mandalorian
titles.overview: After the fall of the Galactic Empire, lawlessness has spread throughout the galaxy. A lone gunfighter makes his way through the outer reaches, earning his keep as a bounty hunter.

episodes.name: Chapter 1: The Mandalorian
episodes.overview: A Mandalorian bounty hunter tracks a target for a well-paying client.

episodes.name: Chapter 2: The Child
episodes.overview: Target in-hand, the Mandalorian must now contend with scavengers.

episodes.name: Chapter 3: The Sin
episodes.overview: The battered Mandalorian returns to his client for reward.

episodes.name: Chapter 4: Sanctuary
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian teams up with an ex-soldier to protect a village from raiders.

episodes.name: Chapter 5: The Gunslinger
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian helps a rookie bounty hunter who is in over his head.

episodes.name: Chapter 6: The Prisoner
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian joins a crew of mercenaries on a dangerous mission.

episodes.name: Chapter 7: The Reckoning
episodes.overview: An old rival extends an invitation for The Mandalorian to make peace.

episodes.name: Chapter 8: Redemption
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian comes face-to-face with an unexpected enemy.

episodes.name: Chapter 9: The Marshal
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian is drawn to the Outer Rim in search of others of his kind.

episodes.name: Chapter 10: The Passenger
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian must ferry a passenger with precious cargo on a risky journey.

episodes.name: Chapter 11: The Heiress
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian braves high seas and meets unexpected allies.

episodes.name: Chapter 12: The Siege
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian rejoins old allies for a new mission.

episodes.name: Chapter 13: The Jedi
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian journeys to a world ruled by a cruel magistrate who has made a powerful enemy.

episodes.name: Chapter 14: The Tragedy
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian and Child travel to an ancient site.

episodes.name: Chapter 15: The Believer
episodes.overview: To move against the Empire, the Mandalorian needs the help of an old enemy.

episodes.name: Chapter 16: The Rescue
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian and his allies attempt a daring rescue.

episodes.name: Chapter 17: The Apostate
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian begins an important journey.

episodes.name: Chapter 18: The Mines of Mandalore
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian and Grogu explore the ruins of a destroyed planet.

episodes.name: Chapter 19: The Convert
episodes.overview: On Coruscant, former Imperials find amnesty in the New Republic.

episodes.name: Chapter 20: The Foundling
episodes.overview: Din Djarin returns to the hidden Mandalorian covert.

episodes.name: Chapter 21: The Pirate
episodes.overview: The people of Nevarro need protection from rampant pirate attacks.

episodes.name: Chapter 22: Guns for Hire
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian visits an opulent world.

episodes.name: Chapter 23: The Spies
episodes.overview: Survivors come out of hiding.

episodes.name: Chapter 24: The Return
episodes.overview: The Mandalorian and his allies confront their enemies.

titles.name: Squid Game
titles.overview: Hundreds of cash-strapped players accept a strange invitation to compete in children's games. Inside, a tempting prize awaits — with deadly high stakes.

episodes.name: Red Light, Green Light
episodes.overview: Hoping to win easy money, a broke and desperate Gi-hun agrees to take part in an enigmatic game. Not long into the first round, unforeseen horrors unfold.

episodes.name: Hell
episodes.overview: Split on whether to continue or quit, the group holds a vote. But their realities in the outside world may prove to be just as unforgiving as the game.

episodes.name: The Man with the Umbrella
episodes.overview: A few players enter the next round — which promises equal doses of sweet and deadly — with hidden advantages. Meanwhile, Jun-ho sneaks his way inside.

episodes.name: Stick to the Team
episodes.overview: As alliances form among the players, no one is safe in the dorm after lights-out. The third game challenges Gi-hun's team to think strategically.

episodes.name: A Fair World
episodes.overview: Gi-hun and his team take turns keeping guard through the night. The masked men encounter trouble with their co-conspirators.

episodes.overview: Hopper breaks into the lab while Nancy and Jonathan confront the force that took Will. The boys ask Mr. Clarke how to travel to another dimension.

episodes.overview: Eleven struggles to reach Will, while Lucas warns that "the bad men are coming." Nancy and Jonathan show the police what Jonathan caught on camera.

episodes.overview: Dr. Brenner holds Hopper and Joyce for questioning while the boys wait with Eleven in the gym. Back at Will's, Nancy and Jonathan prepare for battle.

episodes.overview: An ailing Will opens up to Joyce -- with disturbing results. While Hopper digs for the truth, Eleven unearths a surprising discovery.

episodes.overview: Nancy and Jonathan swap conspiracy theories with a new ally as Eleven searches for someone from her past. “Bob the Brain” tackles a difficult problem.

episodes.name: Cancer Man
episodes.overview: Walter finally tells his family that he has been stricken with cancer. Meanwhile, the DEA believes Albuquerque has a new, big time player to worry about. Meanwhile, a worthy recipient is the target of a depressed Walter's anger, and Jesse makes a surprise visit to his parents home.

episodes.name: Gray Matter
episodes.overview: Walter and Skyler attend a former colleague's party. Jesse tries to free himself from the drugs, while Skyler organizes an intervention.

episodes.name: Crazy Handful of Nothin'
episodes.overview: The side effects of chemo begin to plague Walt. Meanwhile, the DEA rounds up suspected dealers.

episodes.name: A No Rough Stuff Type Deal
episodes.overview: Walter accepts his new identity as a drug dealer after a PTA meeting. Elsewhere, Jesse decides to put his aunt's house on the market and Skyler is the recipient of a baby shower.

episodes.name: Seven Thirty-Seven
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse are vividly reminded of Tuco’s volatile nature, and try to figure a way out of their business partnership. Hank attempts to mend fences between the estranged Marie and Skyler.

episodes.name: Grilled
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse find themselves in close quarters with an unhinged Tuco. Marie and Hank comfort Skyler, who is distraught over Walt’s disappearance. Hank pays a visit to Mrs. Pinkman on some not-so-official business.

episodes.name: Bit by a Dead Bee
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse become short on cash when they try to cover their tracks. Meanwhile, the DEA has a lead that could them straight to Walt and Jesse.

episodes.name: Down
episodes.overview: Walt attempts to reconnect with his family, while Jesse struggles to rebuild his life.

episodes.name: Breakage
episodes.overview: Hank suffers from the aftermath of his encounter with Tuco. Meanwhile, Jesse hires a crew to get their product out on the streets.

episodes.name: Peekaboo
episodes.overview: Walt's secret is in jeopardy when Skyler thanks Gretchen for paying for his treatment.

episodes.name: Negro y Azul
episodes.overview: Jesse and Walt discuss expanding into new territories; Hank struggles to fit in; Skyler pursues a new job opportunity; Jesse gets to know his landlord.

episodes.name: Better Call Saul
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse seek advice from a shady attorney when Badger gets in trouble with the law; the DEA believes they have caught up with "Heisenberg" ; Hank returns.

episodes.name: 4 Days Out
episodes.overview: Walt and his family wait for news after he undergoes a PET-CT scan. Walt follows Saul's advice; Jesse's relationship with Jane is put on hold when he and Walt head to the desert for a marathon of cooking.

episodes.name: Over
episodes.overview: Walt and Hank get into a heated argument at a party. Skyler opens up to her boss. Jane hides her relationship with Jesse from her father.

episodes.name: Mandala
episodes.overview: As the end of her pregnancy finds Skyler conflicted about her feelings, a dealer's death forces Walt to look for somewhere to unload a load of meth.

episodes.name: Phoenix
episodes.overview: As Walt explores money laundering options, he and Jesse spar over the profits from their latest deal. Jesse and Jane clash with her father. Walt makes a fatal decision.

episodes.name: ABQ
episodes.overview: Skyler confronts Walt about his secrecy; Jesse falls apart; and Jane's grief-stricken father takes action that results in further tragedy.

episodes.name: No Más
episodes.overview: Walt faces a new threat, on a new front and deals with an increasingly angry Skyler, who must consider what to do next with her life and the kids. Meanwhile, Jesse comes face-to-face with some startling self-revelations.

episodes.name: Caballo sin Nombre
episodes.overview: Despite ever-increasing tension between Walt and Skyler, he pulls out all the stops in an effort to reconcile with the family. Elsewhere, Saul is instrumental in getting Jesse involved in a most-unusual investment opportunity.

episodes.name: I.F.T.
episodes.overview: Walt ignores Skyler's demands, furthering the rift between them and pushing her to break bad. Still suffering from panic and anxiety attacks, Hank crosses a line at work.

episodes.name: Green Light
episodes.overview: Walt loses control as he reacts to Skyler's news, endangering his job and relationships with Saul and Jesse. Hank throws himself into his blue meth investigation. Jesse enacts a new plan.

episodes.name: Más
episodes.overview: Gus increases his efforts to lure Walt back into business, forcing a rift between Walt and Jesse. Skyler doubts her new relationship. Marie confides in Skyler about her concern for Hank's well-being.

episodes.name: Sunset
episodes.overview: Walt settles into his new surroundings; Walt, Jr. wants answers about his parents' relationship; Hank's investigation causes problems for Walt and Jesse.

episodes.name: One Minute
episodes.overview: Hank's increasing volatility forces a confrontation with Jesse and trouble at work. Skyler pressures Walt to make a deal. Gus' actions have severe consequences.

episodes.name: I See You
episodes.overview: The family waits for news about Hank. While Jesse covers at the lab, Walt attempts to placate Gus. After witnessing a disturbing outburst, Walt worries he and his family are in danger.

episodes.name: Kafkaesque
episodes.overview: As Hank's hospital bills stack up, Skyler hatches a plan. Walt and Gus come to a better understanding. Jesse, looking for more independence, pursues a new opportunity.

episodes.name: Fly
episodes.overview: Walt becomes obsessed with a contaminant in the lab and refuses to finish the cook until it is eliminated. A frustrated Jesse attempts to get Walt back on track.

episodes.name: Abiquiu
episodes.overview: Skyler gets involved with Walt's business. Hank struggles with his recovery. Jesse makes a startling discovery after meeting a girl at group therapy.

episodes.name: Half Measures
episodes.overview: Against Walt's advice, Jesse lashes out. Fearing for Jesse's safety, Walt takes drastic action to intervene and tragic event leads to a shocking confrontation.

episodes.name: Full Measure
episodes.overview: With Jesse on the run and Mike in hot pursuit, Walt negotiates a bargain with Gus and concocts a disturbing plan to provide for his and Jesse's safety.

episodes.name: Box Cutter
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse face the deadly consequences of their actions. Skyler deals with a puzzling disappearance, as Marie struggles to help Hank with his recovery.

episodes.name: Thirty-Eight Snub
episodes.overview: Walt attempts to form a new alliance as he plans his next move. Skyler pushes Walt towards a business opportunity, in hopes of protecting the family.

episodes.name: Open House
episodes.overview: Events spiral out of control at Jesse's place. Skyler reluctantly asks for Saul's help. Marie returns to an old pastime and a friend asks Hank for help.

episodes.name: Bullet Points
episodes.overview: The Cartel takes steps to gain the upper hand. Walt and Skyler share an embarrassing secret with the rest of the family. Jesse's activities draw unwanted attention.

episodes.name: Shotgun
episodes.overview: When Jesse goes missing, Walt fears the worst. Skyler has an unlikely reunion. Hank shares some bad news with Detective Tim Roberts.

episodes.name: Cornered
episodes.overview: Skyler makes an unsettling discovery. Walter, Jr. pushes his dad into a questionable purchase. Jesse offers Mike some unexpected help.

episodes.name: Problem Dog
episodes.overview: A frustrated Walt gambles on a risky new plan. Skyler's business venture hits a snag. Hank recruits Walter, Jr. for an unusual outing.

episodes.name: Hermanos
episodes.overview: Skyler develops an unusual solution to her money troubles. Hank enlists Walt to investigate a theory. Walt's impatience with Jesse grows.

episodes.name: Bug
episodes.overview: Skyler's past mistakes come back to haunt her. Gus takes action to thwart his rivals. Jesse seeks Walt's help, with mixed results.

episodes.name: Salud
episodes.overview: Walt's family worries when he doesn't turn up for Walter, Jr.'s 16th birthday. Jesse is forced to put his lab skills to the test without Mr. White's help.

episodes.name: Crawl Space
episodes.overview: Walt takes drastic action to protect his secret and Gus. Skyler's efforts to solve Ted's financial problems hit a wall.

episodes.name: End Times
episodes.overview: Hank pushes Gomez to pursue one last lead, while Walt struggles to protect the family. Jesse gets alarming news and rushes to meet with Mr. White.

episodes.name: Face Off
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse team up to take on Gus. With Saul's help, Walt finds an unexpected ally.

episodes.name: Live Free or Die
episodes.overview: As Walt deals with the aftermath of the Casa Tranquila explosion, Hank works to wrap up his investigation of Gus' empire.

episodes.name: Madrigal
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse pursue an unlikely business partner. The DEA filters through various leads in hopes of finding something.

episodes.name: Hazard Pay
episodes.overview: Walt and Jesse formulate a new business plan. Walt shares a secret with Marie.

episodes.name: Fifty-One
episodes.overview: Walt celebrates another birthday. Skyler contemplates her options, and an associate puts a crimp in Walt and Jesse's business strategy.

episodes.name: Dead Freight
episodes.overview: Walt's team gets creative to obtain the methylamine they need to continue their operation.

episodes.name: Buyout
episodes.overview: Walt, Jesse, and Mike struggle over the future of their business, as occupational hazards weigh on Jesse.

episodes.name: Say My Name
episodes.overview: Walt takes control of business matters; Mike deals with the consequences of his actions.

episodes.name: Gliding Over All
episodes.overview: Walt takes care of loose ends; Walt makes a dangerous decision.

episodes.name: Blood Money
episodes.overview: As Walt and Jesse adjust to life out of the business, Hank grapples with a troubling lead.

episodes.name: Buried
episodes.overview: While Skyler's past catches up with her, Walt covers his tracks. Jesse continues to struggle with his guilt.

episodes.name: Confessions
episodes.overview: Jesse decides to make a change, while Walt and Skyler try to deal with an unexpected demand.

episodes.name: Rabid Dog
episodes.overview: An unusual strategy starts to bear fruit, while plans are set in motion that could change everything.

episodes.name: To'hajiilee
episodes.overview: Things heat up for Walt in unexpected ways.

episodes.name: Ozymandias
episodes.overview: Everyone copes with radically changed circumstances.

episodes.name: Granite State
episodes.overview: Events set in motion long ago move toward a conclusion.

episodes.name: Felina
episodes.overview: All bad things must come to an end.
